create_plain_agent: create a PlainAgent instance with num_actions, observation_names, and optional LSTM hidden size for A3C/IMPALA navigation
build_initial_state: build the initial zero-state LSTM core for a given batch size using PlainAgent.initial_state
run_network_unroll: run the network unroll over a sequence of actions and environment outputs with episode state reset on done flags
build_convnet_torso: build the residual convnet torso that processes visual frames through conv layers and flattens to core input
build_policy_head: build the policy head that produces action logits, baseline value, and samples a discrete action from the policy
